I reintroduced my bill that would allow federal employees to purchase short-term disability insurance at group rates.

This bill is more important than ever with the emergence of long COVID.

Details: https://t.co/gjWQhpwJhT

After learning that the families of two pedestrians killed in a car crash at Hains Point in DC last year still have not received the information required for them to file a life insurance claim, I wrote NPS demanding answers.

Statement: https://t.co/GYDej5D9CU
After my letter, NPS finally provided the name of the driver to the victims’ families, without which they could not file life insurance claims.

Today, I introduced a bill to require all health insurers to directly reimburse a divorced parent who pays for reimbursable out-of-pocket medical expenses, regardless of which parent is the source of insurance.

Release: https://t.co/n8OC4BQekT

.@SenateGOP just blocked the #PACTAct, a bipartisan bill that would provide health care and benefits to toxic-exposed veterans.

Republicans have repeatedly used the phony pretext of fiscal responsibility to deny health care and benefits to veterans.

https://t.co/JxKlyCgLGW

Today, I spoke at a press conference with @RepChuyGarcia on the Good Jobs for Good Airports Act.

It’s time we made sure airport jobs pay livable wages and provide benefits like health insurance and paid leave–things every worker deserves. https://t.co/vmI6JPQBoq

Thirteen years ago today, the ACA was signed into law. 

As a result of steps I took to ensure DC received equal treatment as the states, health insurance and access to care was improved for the nearly 700,000 DC residents. https://t.co/d5SBIzRn0E

Your address shouldn't determine your access to healthcare or ability to make medical decisions.

Without Roe's protections, DC residents are particularly vulnerable to losing their ability to choose.

Proud to cosponsor the #WHPA to ensure choice for DC and the country. https://t.co/dtyBi23EYp

I will be holding an online roundtable discussion next Tuesday, September 12th from 12:00pm - 1:30pm to discuss the basics of Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid. The roundtable is open to all District of Columbia residents.

URL to Register: https://t.co/i6QIU7IfZ3

DC residents: Open Enrollment, when you can make changes to your health insurance under the Affordable Care Act, has begun!
 
Sign up or make changes to your existing health insurance at https://t.co/UME1dAvOZJ. https://t.co/17yNqbJJGV

Open Season has begun for federal workers! Sign up, switch plans or renew your health, dental and vision benefits by December 11.
 
Learn more: https://t.co/lyay1n57Sl

Health care is a right – not a privilege.

On this day in 2010, the Affordable Care Act was signed into law, and it continues to lower costs and help millions of Americans find affordable, quality health care coverage. https://t.co/iKfFFtCeJ5

Chronic diseases, many caused or exacerbated by obesity, account for approximately 70% of all deaths and 75% of medical costs in the US.
 
I introduced my bill to provide $75 million to the CDC to combat obesity and sedentary lifestyles.
 
More: https://t.co/ASeAg2jUan

Families facing divorce are experiencing significant hardship.
 
I introduced a bill to ensure that children get necessary medical care by requiring health insurers to directly reimburse a divorced parent who pays for certain medical expenses.
 
Statement: https://t.co/WkhTnvpL9B

Federal employees: Open enrollment, the period each year when you can sign up for or change your health care benefits, has begun! 
 
Sign up or make changes by Monday, December 9th to be covered for 2025.

DC residents: Have you signed up for health insurance coverage yet? The 2025 open enrollment period, when you can enroll or make changes to your health insurance, ends on January 31st.
 
Head to https://t.co/UME1dAvOZJ today. https://t.co/xbTLKs9wcl

I introduced my bill urging the US to sign the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, dismantle our existing nuclear weapons, and redirect their funding to health care, housing and addressing the climate crisis.
 
More: https://t.co/r2s8Ufoz0Z

Rep. Chris Smith's disapproval resolution on DC's Insurance Regulation Amendment Act is a fumbled attempted attack on DC home rule, coming too late to have any effect.
 
The congressional review period on the DC law, as governed by the Home Rule Act, has already expired. https://t.co/WH68ZASPEz

DC residents contact me regularly about the negative impact train noise and vibrations have on their health, quality of life, and even the structural integrity of their homes.
 
I introduced a bill to address the problem. https://t.co/BLdsKCTbLn

My constituent’s father, Tofig Yagublu, is on day 24 of his hunger strike in Azerbaijani prison and is rapidly losing weight. 

According to @hrw and @amnesty, Tofig is a political prisoner. I urge @presidentaz to provide him with proper medical care and ultimately release him.

Today, I introduced my bill which would allow individuals with certain medical conditions restroom access in retail establishments, when such an establishment does not have a public restroom. Read my full release here: https://t.co/WYWDBiNerA

As ranking member of the Subcommittee on Highways & Transit, I wrote GAO requesting a study on railway noise pollution, which can cause structural damage and negative health effects.
 
If there are viable ways to mitigate these harms, we should find and implement them. https://t.co/Lx1CoUMYVM

Roe fell three years ago today.

Without the protections of Roe or #DCStatehood, women in DC are uniquely vulnerable to members of Congress from other districts obstructing their access to reproductive health care. https://t.co/sk88d9VYfW

Federal workers ensure:
 
✅Social Security checks go out on time
✅ Veterans get health care
✅ Drinking water is uncontaminated
✅ Planes land safely
 
Their work is critical to our government and making sure people, families and communities get the services they need.

60 years ago today, Democrats and Republicans came together to change the course of American history.  Today, only Democrats are keeping the promise to:
 → Protect Medicare. → Defend Medicaid. → Fight GOP cuts. https://t.co/ccvFxJLagL
